summary: Scraped the Travel category listing at https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/category/books/travel_2/index.html. This category has a single page with no pagination or load-more control (confirmed: extract_table showed 11 rows, and paginate_extract's advance step found no next/more control and scrolling loaded nothing new). All 11 unique entries (name, price, availability, url) were written incrementally via paginate_extract to results.csv, deduplicated by name. Total: 11 rows, 0 duplicates, 0 fai
